title: Boomers, Burners, And Flying Cars With Cal Newport
summary: Georgetown University computer scientist Cal Newport offers questions to pose to Congress about AI regulation, followed by the fellows discussing what’s behind Western Europe’s riots and President Trump’s surly attitude toward Ukraine (most recently, his threat to take away Starlink internet service).

title: Hell Freezes Over
summary: Freezing the Lindsey Graham law is a positive development—yet it is too early to speak of a qualitative change of course, writes Valdai Club Programme Director Ivan Timofeev. Much, if not everything, will be decided on the diplomatic and military front of the Ukrainian conflict.
